parameters.content:
## 📝 Setup checklist before running

1. **Google Sheet** — add these columns to Sheet1 (some already exist): `post_id, idea, post_text, image_prompt, media_type, media_url, post_title, status, telegram_chat_id, telegram_message_id, telegram_file_id, posted_at`
2. **Add idea rows** yourself with `post_id`, `idea` (topic/brief) and `status = idea`. Everything else is filled in automatically.
3. **Telegram bot** — create a bot with @BotFather, then:
   - Set the bot token in BOTH "Config – Bot Token" nodes (Lane 1 and Lane 2)
   - Set your numeric chat id in "Config – Telegram Chat ID" (Lane 1). Message your bot once and check `https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates` to find it.
   - Create a Telegram credential (bot token) and attach it to the "Telegram Trigger" node so n8n can register the webhook.
4. **Gemini** — reuses your existing Google Gemini (PaLM) API credential. Model names used: `gemini-3.5-flash` for text and `gemini-3.1-flash-image` ("Nano Banana 2") for images/image-edits. Check ai.google.dev if these have since been renamed/retired.
5. **LinkedIn** — reuses your existing LinkedIn OAuth2 credential. Remember the known blocker: `registerUpload` returns 403 ACCESS_DENIED until the Community Management API product is approved on your LinkedIn Developer App.
6. Approved posts are NOT published instantly — they wait for the Lane 3 schedule trigger (8AM/5:30PM by default) to actually publish, matching your original design.

## Lane guide

**Lane 1 (top)** — picks up an `idea` row, drafts post text + image with Gemini, sends it to Telegram with Approve / Reject / Edit Text / Edit Image buttons, sets status = `awaiting_review`.

**Lane 2 (middle)** — the Telegram Trigger. Handles button taps (approve/reject/ask-for-edit) and handles plain text replies (treated as edit instructions when a draft is awaiting an edit).

**Lane 3 (bottom)** — your original publish pipeline, now triggered on `status = approved` instead of `pending`, publishing at the scheduled times.

parameters.jsCode:
const idea = $('Get Idea Rows').first().json.idea;
const prompt = 'You are a senior LinkedIn ghostwriter. Based on this idea, write an engaging, '
  + 'scroll-stopping LinkedIn post (150-250 words).

'
  + 'Idea: "' + idea + '"

'
  + 'Rules:
- Start with a strong 1-line hook
- Short punchy paragraphs (1-3 sentences each)
'
  + '- Conversational, first-person tone
- End with 3-5 relevant hashtags
'
  + '- Return ONLY the finished post text, no preamble, no quotation marks, no markdown.';

return [{ json: { ...$json, text_prompt: prompt } }];

parameters.name: reply_markup
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ inline_keyboard: [ [ { text: '✅ Approve', callback_data: 'approve|' + $('Take First Idea').item.json.post_id }, { text: '❌ Reject', callback_data: 'reject|' + $('Take First Idea').item.json.post_id } ], [ { text: '✏️ Edit Text', callback_data: 'edit_content|' + $('Take First Idea').item.json.post_id }, { text: '🖼️ Edit Image', callback_data: 'edit_image|' + $('Take First Idea').item.json.post_id } ] ] }) }}

nodes.name: Save Review State to Sheet
nodes.notes: Writes the AI draft + image location + telegram message info back to the sheet, status=awaiting_review

nodes.name: Telegram Trigger
nodes.notes: Requires a Telegram credential (bot token) so n8n can register the webhook.
